intent: Hold the open state of one menu of a Menubar and tie its MenubarTrigger to the MenubarContent it opens.
typical_uses: One top-level menu of the bar, such as File or View

dont_use_when.situation: A menu of actions on its own, outside any bar
A nested list of further actions inside an open menu

invariants.text: `open` and `defaultOpen` are both accepted; `defaultOpen` seeds the initial state and is ignored afterwards, and when `open` is given it wins and the component follows it on every render.
While open, pressing Escape or pressing outside the popup closes the menu and reports the change through `onOpenChange`.
Inside a Menubar the menu's own `modal` is ignored; whether an open menu locks scroll and blocks the page is decided by the bar's `modal`.

anti_patterns.dont: Hold the open state in the caller and pass `open` without `onOpenChange`
anti_patterns.do_instead: Pass `onOpenChange` alongside `open` and update the state from it, or leave both out; a controlled `open` that nothing updates keeps the menu from opening on a trigger press, from closing on Escape and from being switched to from a sibling menu of the bar

children.states: children is the menu's content, either React nodes or a function of the active trigger's payload that returns them
children.because: `React.ReactNode | PayloadChildRenderFunction<Payload>` - the function form receives `{ payload }` from whichever trigger opened the menu. The compiler emits one JSON type per property, and a function has no JSON Schema representation.

onOpenChange.states: onOpenChange is a callback called with the next open state and event details, not a value
onOpenChange.because: `(open: boolean, eventDetails) => void`; the second argument carries Base UI's change-event details, including the reason (such as a trigger press, an item press, an outside press or Escape). No JSON Schema type covers a function.

onOpenChangeComplete.states: onOpenChangeComplete is a callback called with the open state once the open or close animation has finished
onOpenChangeComplete.because: `(open: boolean) => void` - a function, which no JSON Schema type covers.

actionsRef.states: actionsRef is a ref the menu fills with imperative `close` and `unmount` actions
actionsRef.because: `React.RefObject<MenuRoot.Actions | null>` - a ref object holding functions, which no JSON Schema type covers.

handle.states: handle is an opaque object from the primitive's Menu.createHandle(), shared with a trigger placed outside this menu
handle.because: `MenuHandle<Payload>` is a class instance holding the menu's store, not data; the kit re-exports no createHandle, so a caller imports it from the primitive.

triggerId.states: triggerId is the id of the trigger a controlled menu is open for, or null
triggerId.because: `string | null` - the compiler emits one JSON type per property, so a string-or-null union is left unasserted.

defaultTriggerId.states: defaultTriggerId is the id of the trigger an initially open menu is open for, or null
defaultTriggerId.because: `string | null` - the compiler emits one JSON type per property, so a string-or-null union is left unasserted.

good.title: A View menu opened from state the caller owns

bad.title: A non-modal menu requested on the menu instead of the bar
bad.why: A menu inside a bar ignores its own `modal`, so the page is still locked while the menu is open; pass `modal={false}` to the Menubar.
